description: For a PT that has reached maturity, quote and build UNSIGNED transactions to redeem it for the underlying (or IBT). Before maturity a PT cannot be redeemed, only sold. Nothing is signed or broadcast.

market.description: Market id from spectra_find_yields (e.g. "base:0xa07f…"), a PT or pool address (prefix the chain when you know it), or a symbol fragment such as "sjEUR".

name: spectra_prepare_redeem
title: Prepare a matured PT redemption
